subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in
stimulus: the parentheses. 1×5=5 Mushroom is a small wonder of the day. But we have been neglecting that vegetable for so long. One of the reasons is the (a) ______ (concept) that it grows in filth and soggy places and is something to be avoided. Besides, consumers do not (b) ______ (aware) of its nutritional values, and (c) ______ (medicine) qualities. Mushrooms provide (d) ______ (aware) of its nutritional qualities. Mushrooms provide (d) ______ (aware) substances, (e) ______ (order). Premature hair loss and anaemia.
guide_solution: Suffixes/prefixes: (a) misconception (b) unaware (c) medicinal (d) prevention (e) disorders
